name: Discrete Computed Tomography with Scattering
aliases: Inverse Rendering for Discrete X-Ray CT with Scattering
definition: Extension of discrete CT to include X-ray scattering, addressing the discrete assignment problem where each voxel is assigned one of $m$ known materials, building on continuous inverse problem work by Geva et al. [2018].
summary: Discrete Computed Tomography with Scattering assigns voxels to known materials by modeling both absorption and in-scattered radiance, treating scattered photons as informative signal rather than noise.
